summary: Iteration 5 (Premium subscription launch) tested. Backend: all 12 pytest tests passed (100%). Frontend: paywall, collections, settings, meal-plan, grocery-list, saved, header pill, bottom nav, success polling, and mobile-overflow all verified on 414x896. Spec-vs-impl testid mismatches documented. Cheese sim regression: steps execute but outcome screen did not render in 2 attempts on /simulator (likely auto-navigation side-effect — needs main agent verification).

integration_issues.issue: After ctrl-grill → 8s wait → ctrl-take-out, page navigates to /recipes instead of staying on /simulator with outcome rendered. No [data-testid=outcome], no [data-testid=ctrl-share], no [data-testid=ctrl-reset] visible. Bottom nav 'RECIPES' becomes highlighted. Reproduced twice. Could be a regression introduced when Layout/Routes were updated for premium pages.

save-toggle-{slug} for star, recipe-{slug} for recipe card

nav-sim (still 5 items: nav-home, nav-collections, nav-recipes, nav-sim, nav-settings)

verified_backend_apis: POST /api/users/init creates user, returns premium.tier='trial' with trial_ends_at and premium_until ~3 days out
POST /api/users/init is idempotent on same device_id (trial not regranted)
POST /api/checkout/session monthly: returns checkout.stripe.com URL + session_id; payment_transactions has pending record amount=3.99 granted=False payment_status=initiated
POST /api/checkout/session lifetime: amount=24.99 in transaction record
Referrer flow: POST /api/users/init with referrer_device_id creates row in referrals collection (rewarded=False)
action_items: Investigate cheese sim regression: ctrl-take-out on /simulator appears to navigate to /recipes instead of showing the outcome state. Manual check needed — could be a routing/state side-effect from PremiumProvider or Layout changes.
Optional: add dedicated [data-testid=settings-tier] inside settings-subscription so QA can read tier directly.
Optional: rename [data-testid=affiliate-waitlist] → [data-testid=affiliate-waitlist-btn] to match spec, or update spec.
Optional: clarify in spec that the cheese collection slug is e.g. 'moving-out' (not 'toasted-cheese-map' which is the domain name).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 438 lines — comfortably under the 700-line threshold. Clean module layout (models, helpers, routes).
Idempotency on /users/init relies on existing user lookup before insert; safe.
/checkout/status correctly guards granting via txn.granted flag (idempotent webhook + redirect).
Webhook handler swallows parse errors and still returns 200 — could mask bad signatures; consider logging at error level and returning 4xx for non-Stripe traffic.
Mongo _id is excluded with projection {'_id': 0} on user reads — good.
STRIPE_API_KEY missing returns 500 — acceptable but a startup-time check would fail-fast more clearly.

Compute-premium decides 'trial' vs 'monthly' tier by comparing premium_until <= trial_end. If a paid user is granted on top of trial, premium_until extends beyond trial_end so tier flips to 'monthly' — correct.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all premium flows verified; sim outcome regression unverified

test_credentials: n/a — anonymous device-id identity, no auth
seed_data_creation: TEST-prefixed users/transactions/analytics_events/referrals created and cleaned up by teardown_module in test_premium_api.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Stripe test-mode is fully wired and 100% passing. Frontend premium flows all green. The only flagged issue is the cheese sim outcome screen not rendering in the playwright run — main agent should manually confirm whether /simulator → grill → take-out still displays the outcome card with ctrl-share + ctrl-reset, OR if a recent change accidentally short-circuits to /recipes. Backend test file (/app/backend/tests/test_premium_api.py) is reusable for regression in future iterations.
rca_of_the_issue: Cheese sim: after ctrl-take-out the URL changes to /recipes (visible because bottom nav 'RECIPES' becomes highlighted in screenshot, and outcome+share+reset testids are absent). Hypothesis: either finish(simSec) navigates programmatically on certain timer values, OR a side-effect from the PremiumProvider's focus/visibility listener triggers a route change while Stripe.js (loaded earlier in test sequence) is in the background. Reproduced twice in this session. Needs main agent investigation; could not be reproduced in iter 1-4 because PremiumProvider didn't exist.
